name: particle-academy/fancy-sign
description: E-signature for PHP, designed to support simple electronic signatures (SES): envelopes, signers with email one-time codes to view and to accept, consent and intent captured as hashes, signature/initials/date fields with an auto-appended signature page, a per-envelope hash-chained audit trail, an Ed25519-sealed completion record and a certificate of completion. Standard library only; PDF by fine-print. Framework-free core plus a Laravel bridge.

suggest.illuminate/support: Only for the optional Laravel bridge: migrations, sender and signer routes, mail through the host's mailer. Laravel 13. The framework-free Signing service needs none of it.
